_doc: Fountain tussocks, dry-variegated ribbon grass (reference b3 / b4 / b5: r1 mid / right). 50-80 % cream / straw blades.
avoid: soil, roots, pot, vase, hands, shadows on the background, gradient background, blur, bokeh, depth of field, cartoon, illustration, saturated emerald or blue-green colour, pink or purple tint on the leaves, frame, border, text, watermark

cells.prompt: A fountain-shaped tussock of about eighteen narrow arching grass blades, mostly dry cream and pale straw yellow with some olive green blades near the base, the blades fan out from a dense base at the bottom and arch outward to both sides, pointed tips

A tussock of variegated ribbon grass, about sixteen narrow arching blades with cream edges and a green centre stripe, pale overall, fanning out from the base at the bottom and arching outward, pointed tips
A dense fountain tussock of about twenty narrow arching olive-green grass blades with dry straw-coloured tips, fanning out from the base at the bottom and arching outward, pointed tips
A clump of about twelve stiff narrow dark olive-green grass blades fanning out like a fountain from the base at the bottom, slightly glaucous, a few dry tips, pointed tips
